A '''''Stella''-class frigate''' was a type of [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] used by the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] sometime in [[44 ABY]]. The frigate was capable of deploying at least three [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Miy'til starfighter]]s.<ref name="apocalypse" />

One such frigate was the ''[[Lady Worbi]]''.<ref name="apocalypse" />
